title: Novel froth flotation and magnetic separation process for beneficiation of nickel ore
abstract: This paper describes a froth flotation and magnetic separation process for beneficiation of nickel ore. Results indicate higher recovery and lower energy use than conventional routes.

title: Improved rare earth alloy and cathode materials for battery and magnet applications
abstract: This patent describes a rare earth alloy and cathode materials for battery and magnet applications. Results indicate higher recovery and lower energy use than conventional routes.
